title: Identification of interleukin-11 as a comorbid risk factor for prostate cancer and Alzheimer's disease using integrated bioinformatics and machine learning.
rationale_c1: Public AD and PCa cohorts are convenience samples not population-representative.
rationale_c2: Transcriptomic and clinical endpoints are standard and matched to aims.
rationale_c3: PFI and follow-up completeness vary across merged public cohorts.
rationale_c4: Comorbidity pairing and batch effects may confound prognostic signature claims.
rationale_c5: Computational and lab IL11 manipulations follow stated protocols.
probast_rationale: Convenience cohorts plus median-split risk score and extensive ML on TCGA.
appraisal_note: Borderline: AD comorbidity focus vs GU biomarker scope.

title: Machine learning-based identification of hub genes and prognostic biomarkers in prostate cancer.
rationale_c1: TCGA-PRAD single public cohort, not population-representative.
rationale_c2: RNA-seq expression and clinical BCR endpoints appropriate to aims.
rationale_c3: 554 samples with reasonably complete clinical annotation from GDC.
rationale_c4: No external validation cohort; only internal 70/30 split of same TCGA data risks optimism.
rationale_c5: qRT-PCR/ELISA experimental validation followed stated protocols.
probast_rationale: Single-cohort TCGA with internal split only; multi-algorithm (LASSO/RF/SVM/XGBoost) mining typical of corpus.
appraisal_note: Single-cohort TCGA-PRAD study; no independent external validation cohort despite otherwise thorough nomogram/DCA/immune analyses.

title: Integrative Bioinformatics and Machine Learning Analysis Identifies Novel Molecular Biomarkers in Prostate Adenocarcinoma.
rationale_c1: TCGA-PRAD nodal-status subgroup, public convenience cohort.
rationale_c2: RNA-seq DEGs and nodal status appropriate to aims.
rationale_c3: 342 N0 / 78 N1 samples with reasonably complete annotation.
rationale_c4: External validation in independent GSE14206 cohort mitigates confounding/overfitting concerns.
rationale_c5: Graph-convolutional feature selection and ML pipeline followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: TCGA discovery + GSE14206 external validation (AUC 0.90-0.95); still high-dimensional multi-algorithm mining typical of omics signatures.

title: A Platform-Independent Binary Gene-Pair Signature Derived from CRPC-Enriched Single-Cell Transcriptomics for Predicting Recurrence-Free Survival in Prostate Cancer.
rationale_c1: scRNA-seq + TCGA-PRAD training cohort (n=493), public/convenience samples.
rationale_c2: Gene-pair binary signature and RFS endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: 1187 patients across training + 5 external cohorts with adequate follow-up.
rationale_c4: Benchmarked 12 algorithms/104 combos with 5 independent external validation cohorts; strong confounder handling.
rationale_c5: Virtual knockout and pipeline followed stated computational protocol.
probast_rationale: Extensive multi-cohort external validation (C-index avg 0.725 across 5 cohorts) but still platform-independent gene-pair mining with 104 algorithm combinations screened.

title: A Hypoxia and Immune Escape-Related Gene Signature for the Diagnosis of Prostate Cancer: An Integrated Bioinformatics Study.
rationale_c1: TCGA-PRAD single public cohort (554 samples), convenience sample.
rationale_c2: WGCNA hub genes and BCR endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: 501 tumor/52 normal samples reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: No external validation cohort beyond internal 70/30 TCGA split; risk score derived and validated exclusively within TCGA-PRAD (author-acknowledged limitation).
rationale_c5: qRT-PCR and ELISA in cell lines followed stated protocols.
probast_rationale: Single-cohort TCGA study; authors explicitly state external validation in independent cohorts is required before clinical implementation.
appraisal_note: Authors explicitly acknowledge lack of external validation as a limitation.

title: A Metabolic-Related Gene Signature for Predicting Biochemical Recurrence After Radical Prostatectomy: An Integrative Analysis and Targeted Therapeutic Validation.
rationale_c1: Public database-derived cohort (implied TCGA/GEO), convenience sample.
rationale_c2: WGCNA + XGBoost-Cox metabolic gene features appropriate to BCR aim.
rationale_c3: Reasonably complete training/validation reporting (5-yr AUC given for both).
rationale_c4: Only internal training/validation split reported; no genuinely independent external cohort described in accessible text.
rationale_c5: IHC on 32 clinical specimens and in vitro EGCG assays followed stated protocols.
probast_rationale: Training AUC 0.858 vs validation AUC 0.745 suggests some optimism; XGBoost-Cox mining with SHAP but no clearly independent external cohort.
appraisal_note: Notable AUC drop training->validation (0.858->0.745); no clearly independent external cohort identified in extracted text.

title: Deep learning based on multiparametric MRI for differentiating benign from malignant PI-RADS 3 prostate lesions: a dual-center study.
rationale_c1: Dual-center retrospective cohort; potential referral/selection bias, PI-RADS3-only subset.
rationale_c2: Deep-learning radiomics features and benign/malignant outcome appropriate.
rationale_c3: 382 patients across training/internal/external sets, reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: Combined model integrates clinical variables; DeLong tests and calibration performed.
rationale_c5: Blinded segmentation and standardized workflow followed protocol.
probast_rationale: True external validation cohort (Center 2, n=82) present; still retrospective PI-RADS3 subset with radiomics/DL high-dimensional features.

title: Non-invasive prediction of lymph node involvement in prostate cancer via machine learning on whole-prostate MRI.
rationale_c1: Retrospective single/multi-institution cohort (n=339), potential referral bias.
rationale_c2: MRI radiomics/DL features and LNI (pathology-confirmed) outcome appropriate.
rationale_c3: 339 patients with pathology-confirmed LNI status, reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: Composite model built on Briganti nomogram clinical variables plus radiomics/DL; DCA performed.
rationale_c5: Standardized MRI segmentation and 5-fold CV followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: Only internal 7:3 split validation (no external cohort); radiomics+DL high-dimensional features risk overfitting despite good AUC (0.92).
appraisal_note: No external cohort identified — only internal training/validation split.

title: Preoperative dual-ROI mpMRI radiomics integrating intratumoral and periprostatic adipose tissue features with clinical factors for predicting positive surgical margins after radical prostatectomy.
rationale_c1: Two-center retrospective cohort (n=423), pooled and randomly split (not center-stratified external validation).
rationale_c2: Dual-ROI mpMRI radiomics and PSM (pathology-confirmed) outcome appropriate.
rationale_c3: 423 patients with reasonably complete radiomics/clinical data.
rationale_c4: Multivariable logistic regression combining TPR signature with clinical predictors (PSA, ISUP, T stage).
rationale_c5: Standardized segmentation, reproducibility filtering, and 1000-iteration bootstrap followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: Random 7:3 split of pooled two-center data (not a true independent external validation by center); high-dimensional radiomics feature selection.
appraisal_note: Training/validation split is a random split of pooled two-center data rather than a true held-out external cohort.

title: Serum Untargeted Metabolomics Integrated with SHAP-Based Machine Learning for Multiclass Stratification of Prostate Cancer, Prostatitis, and Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia.
rationale_c1: Single small public repository (MTBLS6039, n=80), convenience sample.
rationale_c2: Serum untargeted metabolomics and multiclass diagnostic categories appropriate.
rationale_c3: Out-of-fold accuracy/macro-F1 reported across nested CV, reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: Small sample (n=80) and explicit author-acknowledged lack of external independent validation.
rationale_c5: SHAP analysis and nested CV followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: Small single-dataset sample (n=80); nested CV only, no external validation — authors explicitly flag this limitation.
appraisal_note: Small sample (n=80); authors explicitly state lack of external independent validation as a limitation.

title: Network toxicology & molecular docking: endocrine-disrupting chemicals induce prostate cancer - a system study.
rationale_c1: Public GEO discovery (GSE46602/GSE55945) + 3 validation cohorts, convenience samples.
rationale_c2: Transcriptomic/network toxicology features and PCa diagnosis endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: 5 datasets integrated with reasonably complete reporting.
rationale_c4: No clinical covariate adjustment beyond gene expression classification (diagnostic biomarker focus).
rationale_c5: Molecular docking and stacking ensemble followed stated computational protocol.
probast_rationale: Small public microarray/GEO datasets pooled with stacking ensemble across cohorts (AUC>0.90); still small-sample high-dimensional mining typical of corpus.

title: A novel prognostic signature based on mitochondrial permeability transition-driven necrosis genes for biochemical recurrence prediction in prostate cancer.
rationale_c1: TCGA-PRAD public training cohort (n=396), convenience sample.
rationale_c2: MPT-DN gene features and BCR-FS endpoint (per AUA 2019) appropriate.
rationale_c3: TCGA (n=396) + GSE70768 (n=111) with harmonized follow-up.
rationale_c4: Independent prognostic factors (risk score, Gleason, T stage, PSA) confirmed via multivariate Cox.
rationale_c5: WGCNA/DE/Cox/ML pipeline followed stated protocol; protein expression validated PCa vs normal tissue.
probast_rationale: TCGA train + GSE70768 external validation present, but discrimination modest (AUC 0.65-0.70) reflecting typical omics signature analysis-domain risk.
appraisal_note: Modest discrimination (AUC ~0.65-0.70) despite genuine external validation cohort.

title: Development and validation of an MRI radiomics-based model for predicting progression risk in prostate cancer after endocrine therapy.
rationale_c1: Small retrospective cohort (n=136+52), single/dual-center, potential selection bias.
rationale_c2: MRI radiomics + clinicopathological features and PFS endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: Training/internal/external cohorts reasonably complete; median follow-up reported.
rationale_c4: Multivariable independent predictors (PSA nadir, Gleason, T stage, bone metastasis) combined with radiomics.
rationale_c5: Standardized radiomics extraction and nomogram construction followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: Genuine external validation cohort (n=52, C-index 0.795) present, but overall small sample (n=136 total training+internal) and drop from training (0.884) to external C-index (0.795) suggests some overfitting.

title: Bioinformatics and machine learning integration reveals a novel 4-gene (GFUS, ARHGAP8, NBL1, and ACTB) biomarker model for prostate cancer.
rationale_c1: Combined small public GEO microarray cohorts (n=179), convenience/batch-affected.
rationale_c2: Gene expression features and cancer/non-cancer diagnostic labels appropriate.
rationale_c3: 179 discovery + 50 independent validation samples, reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: Batch used as covariate but no clinical confounder adjustment beyond diagnosis label; small samples.
rationale_c5: Novel graph-convolutional feature selection + hybrid RF-LightGBM followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: Small combined microarray cohorts with ensemble stacking (discovery AUC 0.96); independent GSE46602 validation (AUC 0.90) present but still small-sample high-dim mining.

title: Multi-omics analyses related to unfolded protein response in prostate cancer implicate pro-tumor role of IFRD1.
rationale_c1: TCGA training + public GEO cohorts, convenience samples.
rationale_c2: UPR-related gene features (single-cell + bulk) and BCR/survival endpoints appropriate.
rationale_c3: TCGA training + 3 external validation cohorts, reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: Multivariate Cox confirmed UPRRS independent of clinical stage and Gleason score.
rationale_c5: In silico + in vitro IFRD1 knockdown validation followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: TCGA train + 3 external GEO cohorts (C-index>0.82, AUC>0.80); still multi-algorithm consensus signature mining typical of corpus.
appraisal_note: TCGAplot package code available on GitHub, but this is a supporting visualization tool rather than the full model pipeline.

title: Palmitoylation-related gene expression and its prognostic value in prostate cancer: insights into immune infiltration and therapeutic potential.
rationale_c1: TCGA + multiple public/commercial databases (DKFZ, MSKCC, GEO, ArrayExpress, PCaProfiler, PCaDB), convenience.
rationale_c2: Palmitoylation-related gene features and BCR endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: TCGA training + multiple external cohorts, extensive clinical annotation.
rationale_c4: 10-algorithm ensemble; risk stratified by age, stage, node, PSA, Gleason.
rationale_c5: CHRNA2 knockdown validated in cell lines and human samples per stated protocol.
probast_rationale: Extensive external validation (DKFZ, MSKCC, E-MTAB-6128, GSE70768) but 10-algorithm combination mining is a strong overfitting-risk signal typical of the corpus.

title: Genetic relationships between the gut microbiota and prostate cancer: Mendelian randomization combined with bioinformatics analysis.
rationale_c1: Small public GEO datasets (train 3 + validation 1) plus GWAS summary statistics (FINRISK), convenience.
rationale_c2: Mendelian randomization + DEAG features and PCa diagnosis endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: Multiple GEO datasets integrated, reasonably complete reporting.
rationale_c4: MR causal inference is separate from prediction-model confounding; nomogram feature selection not clearly confounder-adjusted.
rationale_c5: MR + ML pipeline followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: External validation reported an implausible AUC=1.0 for one feature gene in a small GEO validation set — strong overfitting/small-sample red flag.
appraisal_note: External validation AUC=1.0 for one feature gene is implausible/overfitting red flag; diagnostic performance claims should be treated cautiously.

title: Integrative single-cell and spatial transcriptomics with explainable AI reveal lethal prognostic axis in prostate cancer.
rationale_c1: Merged public single-cell/spatial + bulk transcriptomic cohorts, convenience sample.
rationale_c2: Explainable-AI (SHAP) derived risk score and RFS endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: Merged training + TCGA-PRAD/MSKCC/GSE70770 external cohorts, reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: HR adjusted for age, Gleason score, T stage in multivariate analysis.
rationale_c5: Single-cell/spatial pipeline and explainable AI followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: Multiple independent external cohorts (TCGA-PRAD, MSKCC, GSE70770; AUC 0.70-0.85) validate the C4-based risk score; still SHAP/explainable-AI mining across combined public data.

title: Development and Validation of a Multimodal Artificial Intelligence-derived Digital Pathology-based Biomarker Predicting Metastasis Among Patients with Biochemical Recurrence After Radical Prostatectomy in NRG/RTOG Trials.
rationale_c1: Locked MMAI model (v1.1) validated in prespecified, well-characterized NRG/RTOG randomized-trial-derived cohort (n=533); high-quality trial-collected data.
rationale_c2: Digital pathology + clinical variables (Grade Group, T-stage, PSA, age, margin) appropriate and prespecified.
rationale_c3: Median follow-up 9.3 years from cooperative-group trial data; low expected missingness.
rationale_c4: Subdistribution HR adjusted for clinical variables and treatment via Cox regression.
rationale_c5: Locked, prespecified model version applied without further tuning.
criteria_note: MMAT non-randomized (Hong 2018); exceptional case per calibration note 2 given locked-model validation in randomized trial cohort.
probast_rationale: Trial-derived cohort with prespecified locked model is low risk of bias for participants/predictors/outcome domains; analysis marked unclear because standard calibration plots were not used and probability calibration was not explicitly assessed.
appraisal_note: Strongest study in batch: locked biomarker model externally validated in NRG/RTOG randomized-trial cohorts (tdAUC 0.74 vs 0.68 clinical nomogram); data available by request from NCTN/NRG only (not fully open), so transparency marked partial.

title: Senescence-related gene signature predicts prostate cancer progression and identifies PCNA as a therapeutic target via multi-omics machine learning integration.
rationale_c1: 6 public cohorts + in-house SYSU-PRAD cohort (n=90), convenience samples.
rationale_c2: Senescence-related gene features and BCR endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: TCGA training + 5 external cohorts + in-house cohort, reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: Temporal trajectory and cohort-specific cutoffs adjusted for context; consistent across cohorts.
rationale_c5: In vitro/in vivo PCNA functional validation followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: 117 machine learning methods benchmarked to select best model — substantial multiple-model-selection/overfitting risk despite 6 external cohorts + in-house validation.

title: A New Radiotranscriptomic Approach to Analyze Combined Sets of T3b Stage-Specific Genes and Radiomic Features in Prostate Cancer.
rationale_c1: Very small prospective single-center cohort (n=48), imbalanced 35 T2c vs 13 T3b.
rationale_c2: CEUS radiomics + transcriptomic features and staging outcome appropriate.
rationale_c3: Small imbalanced sample may limit reliability of reported outcome completeness.
rationale_c4: No external validation; authors explicitly flag need for multi-ethnic validation in larger cohorts due to small T3b subgroup.
rationale_c5: Prospective protocol with IRB approval followed as stated.
probast_rationale: Very small imbalanced sample (n=48, 13 T3b) with near-perfect AUCs (up to 0.998) in several classifiers — strong overfitting signal; no external validation.
appraisal_note: Very small sample (n=48, 13 T3b), near-perfect AUCs (0.99+) suggest high overfitting risk; no external validation; data not publicly available.

title: Identification of Potential Biomarkers in Prostate Cancer Microarray Gene Expression Leveraging Explainable Machine Learning Classifiers.
rationale_c1: Small single tissue-microarray dataset (n=102, GSE68907), convenience sample.
rationale_c2: XML classifier features and severity/diagnosis labels appropriate.
rationale_c3: 102 samples with SMOTE-balanced classes, reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: No external validation cohort; only stratified k-fold CV within single small dataset; SMOTE oversampling increases overfitting risk.
rationale_c5: ML pipeline with SHAP explainability followed stated protocol; full code published.
probast_rationale: Small single-dataset sample (n=102) with SMOTE oversampling and no external validation cohort; k-fold CV only.
appraisal_note: Full analysis code published on GitHub (strong transparency) but no external validation cohort; small n=102.

title: Identification of programmed cell death associated key genes in benign prostatic hyperplasia and prostate cancer development by integrated bioinformatics analysis and machine learning.
rationale_c1: Small public GEO datasets (GSE119195, GSE55597), convenience samples.
rationale_c2: PCD-related gene features and BPH/PCa risk labels appropriate.
rationale_c3: Reasonably complete reporting across both GEO datasets.
rationale_c4: No genuinely independent external cohort; near-perfect AUC (1.0) in GSE119195 explicitly flagged by authors as implausible and requiring further validation.
rationale_c5: Four-ML-method feature reduction followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: Authors themselves note the perfect AUC (1.0) in GSE119195 warrants further validation in larger independent cohorts — strong self-acknowledged overfitting signal.
appraisal_note: Authors explicitly flag AUC=1.0 in GSE119195 as implausible; no genuine independent external cohort beyond the two source GEO datasets used for cross-comparison.

title: Methylation-based signature to distinguish indolent and aggressive prostate cancer.
rationale_c1: Single retrospective institutional cohort (n=120), no external population.
rationale_c2: Whole-genome enzymatic methylation sequencing features and progression endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: Long-term clinical follow-up reported, reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: Only internal split by intermediate-risk stratum used as 'validation'; authors note limited statistical power from cohort size; no independent external cohort.
rationale_c5: EM-seq methodology and ML biomarker selection followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: Single-center n=120 cohort; validation cohort is an internal risk-stratum subset rather than a genuinely independent external cohort; authors note power limitations.
appraisal_note: Code/figures available via GitHub (good transparency); no true external cohort — validation was an internal intermediate-risk subgroup split.

title: Integrated Analysis of Single-Cell RNA Sequencing and Machine Learning Reveals a T Cell-Specific PANoptosis Signature Predicting Prognosis and Immunotherapy in Prostate Cancer.
rationale_c1: TCGA training and scRNA discovery cohorts may not represent all PCa patients.
rationale_c2: Expression and immunotherapy endpoints fit the prognostic question.
rationale_c3: Registry survival and immunotherapy cohorts report outcome data adequately.
rationale_c4: 101-model screen without full independent lock before validation.
rationale_c5: Signature built from predefined scRNA-T cell gene pipeline as described.
probast_rationale: High ROB from cohort selection and algorithm mining with median risk split.

title: Quantification of intratumoral heterogeneity using habitat-based MRI radiomics for predicting high-Gleason scores and castration-resistant PCa: retrospective study.
rationale_c1: Single-center retrospective cohort (n=264), selection bias risk explicitly noted by authors.
rationale_c2: Habitat MRI radiomics features and high-GS/CRPC endpoints appropriate.
rationale_c3: Task 2 CRPC subgroup has only 25 events among 142 followed patients — limited outcome completeness for that task.
rationale_c4: No external validation cohort; authors explicitly state external validation and prospective studies are needed.
rationale_c5: Standardized MRI feature extraction followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: Single-center retrospective design with only internal 7:3 split; Task 2 has only 25 CRPC events, raising overfitting concern; authors explicitly flag lack of external validation as a limitation.
appraisal_note: Single-center retrospective; Task 2 CRPC subgroup has only 25 events (n=142 followed), high overfitting risk; authors explicitly state need for external validation.

title: Unveiling prognostic biomarkers and immunotherapeutic insights in prostate cancer through multi-omics and machine learning.
rationale_c1: TCGA training + public GEO/DKFZ cohorts, convenience samples.
rationale_c2: Multi-omics (bulk+single-cell) immune/prognostic gene features and BCR endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: TCGA training + DKFZ + GSE116918 external cohorts, reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: Multivariate analysis supports IPRS as independent prognostic marker; clinical nomogram integrates covariates.
rationale_c5: BCAM expression/function validated in cells and tissue per stated protocol.
probast_rationale: 14 algorithms/162 combinations benchmarked (extensive mining) though validated in DKFZ and GSE116918 external cohorts.

title: PA2G4 in CAFs promotes biochemical recurrence of prostate cancer via H3K18la.
rationale_c1: TCGA training + public GEO cohorts (single-cell + bulk), convenience samples.
rationale_c2: CAF lactate-metabolism transcriptomic features and BCR endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: TCGA training + 3 external testing cohorts (GSE54460, GSE116918, GSE70769), reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: Nomogram incorporates Gleason grade, PSA, T-stage alongside LMCAFCPI; IMvigor210 used for immunotherapy relevance.
rationale_c5: PA2G4 knockdown, CUT-TAG, and functional assays followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: 3 external testing cohorts validate LMCAFCPI; still multi-algorithm mining (best-average-C-index selection) typical of corpus.

title: Identification and validation of the PARP inhibitor-related gene KANK3 for predicting prognosis and immunotherapeutic response in prostate cancer.
rationale_c1: TCGA + cBioPortal/GEO public cohorts, convenience samples.
rationale_c2: PARP-inhibitor-related gene features and BCRFS endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: TCGA training + GSE70769/GSE189186 external validation, reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: Independent validations across multiple external cohorts using C-index as evaluative metric.
rationale_c5: Cell experiments (proliferation/migration/invasion) for KANK3 followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: Multiple external validation cohorts (GSE70769, GSE189186) present; random forest selection among multiple ML frameworks is typical mining-related risk.

title: Development of a prostate cancer biochemical recurrence risk signature using machine learning and motor protein-related genes.
rationale_c1: TCGA (n=321) + MSKCC2010 (n=140) + GSE70769 (n=92), public convenience cohorts.
rationale_c2: Motor-protein-related gene features and BCR endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: Three-cohort data with cross-cohort batch correction, reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: StepCox+Ridge model selected via C-index across cohorts; nomogram integrates T stage.
rationale_c5: In vitro validation of MPRG expression trends confirmed bioinformatic findings.
probast_rationale: 117 algorithm combinations screened (extensive mining); MSKCC2010 and GSE70769 serve as genuine external validation cohorts.

title: Development of a prognostic risk model for predicting biochemical recurrence-free survival in patients with prostate cancer based on lysine acetylation.
rationale_c1: TCGA-PRAD + GSE54460 public cohorts, convenience samples.
rationale_c2: Lysine-acetylation gene features and BCR-free survival endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: TCGA training + GSE54460 (n=100) external validation, reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: Independent prognostic factors identified via multivariate analysis; nomogram integrates Gleason/T stage.
rationale_c5: WGCNA/DEG/ML pipeline followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: GSE54460 external validation cohort (n=100, modest size) present; WGCNA+DEG intersection plus ML mining typical of corpus default.

title: Biparametric MRI-based radiomics for differentiating clinically significant prostate cancer among prostate-specific antigen level of gray zone.
rationale_c1: Single-center retrospective cohort (n=287), PSA gray-zone subset only.
rationale_c2: bpMRI radiomics features and biopsy-confirmed csPCa outcome appropriate.
rationale_c3: 287 patients with training/test split, reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: Combined nomogram integrates radiomics with PI-RADS; DeLong tests compare models.
rationale_c5: LASSO feature selection and logistic regression followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: Only internal train(201)/test(86) split; authors explicitly state further external validation is needed — no independent external cohort.
appraisal_note: Single-center retrospective study; authors explicitly note need for further external validation.

title: Tumor associated neutrophils promote prostate cancer progression by mediating neutrophil trap secretion through PSMA1- NF-κB-HIF-1α signaling axis.
rationale_c1: TCGA (n=486) public cohort with internal 70/30 split, convenience sample.
rationale_c2: NET-related gene features and prognosis endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: TCGA + GEO validation cohort, reasonably complete reporting.
rationale_c4: Multivariate regression confirmed risk score as independent prognostic factor.
rationale_c5: Single-cell sequencing and organoid model functional validation followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: Internal 70/30 TCGA split plus GEO cohort validation; LASSO+ML mining of 6-gene signature typical of corpus default.

title: Habitat analysis based on magnetic resonance imaging for the prediction of prostate cancer: a dual-center study.
rationale_c1: Retrospective dual-center cohort (n=673), potential selection bias.
rationale_c2: Habitat MRI radiomics and PCa-vs-BPH diagnosis outcome appropriate.
rationale_c3: Internal 8:2 split plus external validation set, reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: Nomogram combines habitat/classical rad-scores with clinically independent predictors.
rationale_c5: Standardized habitat clustering and radiomics extraction followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: Genuine external validation cohort present (AUC 0.878-0.963); still high-dimensional habitat radiomics feature space typical mining risk.

title: Single-Cell and Bulk RNA Sequencing Highlights Intra-Tumoral Heterogeneity and Malignant Progression Mechanisms in Prostate Cancer.
rationale_c1: TCGA training + public GEO/DKFZ cohorts, convenience samples.
rationale_c2: Single-cell + bulk RNA-seq PCMP gene features and RFS endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: TCGA training + 7 external cohorts (GSE70768/70769/21032/46602, DKFZ, GSE116918, Meta), reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: Multivariable Cox regression conducted in multiple cohorts confirms independent prognostic value.
rationale_c5: IHC and cell proliferation assays (CENPA, CKS1B) followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: 101 prediction models benchmarked via 10-fold CV across 6 cohorts (extensive mining); exceptionally thorough external validation across 7 cohorts partially offsets this.

title: A Promising Prognostic Signature Consisting of Fatty Acid Metabolism Genes based on Machine Learning Predicts Biochemical Recurrence and Aids ARSI Therapy in Prostate Cancer.
rationale_c1: TCGA training (n=463) + public GEO cohorts, convenience samples.
rationale_c2: Fatty-acid-metabolism gene features and BCR endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: TCGA training + 5 external validation cohorts including ARSI-treatment cohort, reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: Independent cohorts and clinical covariates incorporated; C-index compared across models.
rationale_c5: 10-algorithm ML pipeline and drug sensitivity analysis followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: 10-algorithm combination mining across 6 cohorts (Cambridge, others); validated in 5 external cohorts including a treatment-response (ARSI) cohort.

title: Integrative analysis of lactylation related genes in prostate cancer: unveiling heterogeneity through single-cell RNA-seq, bulk RNA-seq and machine learning.
rationale_c1: TCGA-PRAD + GSE116918 + GSE54460 merged/cross-validated cohorts, convenience samples.
rationale_c2: Lactylation-related gene features (single-cell + bulk) and prognosis endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: Merged cohort with cross-validation across the three source datasets, reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: LRGRS identified as independent prognostic factor via multivariate analysis.
rationale_c5: qRT-PCR validation of top 10 genes in clinical samples followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: Cross-validated across TCGA-PRAD, GSE116918, GSE54460 (AUC 0.79-0.88 per cohort); multi-algorithm consensus mining typical of corpus default.

title: Comprehensive analysis of cholesterol metabolism-related genes in prostate cancer: integrated analysis of single-cell and bulk RNA sequencing.
rationale_c1: TCGA training + DKFZ/GSE46602/GSE70769 public cohorts, convenience samples.
rationale_c2: Cholesterol-metabolism gene (CMG) features and prognosis endpoint appropriate.
rationale_c3: TCGA training + 3 external cohorts, reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: Risk score recognized as independent prognostic parameter, incorporated into nomogram with clinical variables.
rationale_c5: Single-cell RNA sequencing analyses followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: 3 external validation cohorts (DKFZ, GSE46602, GSE70769) present; LASSO selection from many CMGs typical mining risk.

title: Assessment of prostate cancer aggressiveness through the combined analysis of prostate MRI and 2.5D deep learning models.
rationale_c1: Single-center retrospective cohort (n=335), class-imbalanced (266 aggressive vs 69 non-aggressive).
rationale_c2: 2.5D deep learning + radiomics features and Gleason>=7 aggressiveness outcome appropriate.
rationale_c3: 335 patients with 7:3 train/test split, reasonably complete.
rationale_c4: Clinical feature model (Clinic-LightGBM) combined with imaging models; DeLong tests performed.
rationale_c5: Blinded segmentation with ICC reproducibility check followed stated protocol.
probast_rationale: Only internal 7:3 split, no external validation cohort; deep-learning + radiomics high-dimensional features with class imbalance.

rationale_c5: MRI acquisition and radiomic pipeline applied consistently as intended.
criteria_note: MMAT v2018 quantitative non-randomized (single-center retrospective, internal train/test split only, no external validation).
probast_rationale: Single-center study with only 28 csPCa events supporting a 4-feature radiomic score plus clinical nomogram, no external validation cohort, and reference standard mixes biopsy and prostatectomy pathology (potential verification bias).

title: A Novel Artificial Intelligence-Powered Method for Prediction of Early Recurrence of Prostate Cancer After Prostatectomy and Cancer Drivers.
rationale_c1: TCGA-PRAD subset (243/500 patients with available BCR status) plus an independent University of Wisconsin cohort (n=173); selection based on outcome availability could introduce bias.
rationale_c2: H&E whole-slide imaging with deep convolutional neural network feature extraction, plus orthogonal IHC/biomarker validation, is an appropriate measurement approach.
rationale_c3: BCR status clearly defined and available for all included patients in both cohorts.
rationale_c4: Multivariate analysis combined AI-morphometric score with pathologic parameters (GGG, pT stage, margin status).
rationale_c5: WSI scanning, tiling and model pipeline applied consistently across both cohorts.
criteria_note: MMAT v2018 quantitative non-randomized (TCGA training + independent UW external validation, deep learning model).
probast_rationale: TCGA training subset was selected based on presence/absence of BCR (243/500), a potential source of selection bias; DCNN feature extraction from WSI tiles is a complex, largely uninterpretable predictor pipeline; relatively small training set (n=243) for a deep-learning model despite external validation.
appraisal_note: Source code explicitly withheld pending patent approval, limiting reproducibility/transparency despite otherwise strong external validation.

title: Development and Validation of a Radiomics Nomogram for Predicting Clinically Significant Prostate Cancer in PI-RADS 3 Lesions.
